newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday on the back of moderate demand, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,460-65 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,455 rupiah.

The traders said crude palm oil was done at 1,303.80 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan, while another tender for a similar amount was done at 1,298.25 rupiah. The previous tender price was 1,270 rupiah.
